annotations.title: Release or discard a held reporter update

description: Send (action=release, the default) or drop (action=discard) one held reporter message from list_reporter_outbox; bodyOverride replaces its text before sending. Returns { delivered, skipped, failed }. Write; messages a real end user — confirm with the user first. Idempotent in effect: a message that is no longer held returns CONFLICT instead of sending twice.

action.description: release (default) sends it; discard drops it
